profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineering lead, primarily interested in graphics, games, VR / AR.

Experience across the spectrum of both 0->1 engineering to large, mature software systems. Combination of tech lead and engineering management experience. 

Full-stack with deep mobile knowledge, but flexible and easily adaptable to any technology or domain.
Foundational knowledge in computer graphics and game technologies.

A personal principle is that I want to work on a product or ideal that I strongly resonate with, and I am flexible in choosing or adapting to whatever technology I need to do so. Interested in both end-user products as well as infrastructure / platforms.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech lead working on virtual reality systems (real-time rendering + simulation) for Meta Quest headsets. 

Working on HorizonOS, shipped on all Quest devices (Quest 2, Pro, 3, 3s).

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
I was hired as the 1st / founding software engineer in Meta's Seoul site.

Tech lead for a team of 6 engineers (distributed across the world) that was building a new app for the Korean market as part of Meta’s in-house incubator program NPE (New Product Experimentation).

Responsible for the entire app’s technical success, building it from 0 to 1.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: See "Meta" section.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead Manager
positions.description:
- Tech Lead Manager, led a medium-sized SWE engineering team building a new big bet (new visual-focused page framework).
- Led a team owning a Desktop-focused organized-by-intent search page framework, adopted for use across 15+ vertical teams and 10%+ Google search traffic.
- Consistently received amongst the highest engineering manager-satisfaction scores at the Seoul site.
- Collaborated / roadmapped cross-functionally and across multiple platform partner teams.
- Hiring committee member: collaborated on final hiring decisions for 70+ candidates.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Full stack tech lead on YouTube Gaming.
- Most notably, I led the engineering team that built and scaled YouTube Clips.
- Built the landing page for gaming content (https://www.youtube.com/gaming) on YouTube on iOS (client, and significant portion of backend).
- Hosted an intern (converted to FTE), conducted 100+ interviews, revamped the team's oncall processes.
- Managed deployment to app store for multiple releases (integrating changes from dozens of engineers) of the main YouTube iOS app for 100 million+ users
- Internal certification for C++, Python, and API design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Bruno, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Second iOS engineer on YouTube TV.
- Developed many critical portions of the iOS app (player and watch experience, show pages, tablet support, experimental features) in a scrappy environment.
- Launched as a team in 2017. App has millions of paid subscribers to date.
- Internal certification for Objective-C

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: See "Google" section.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Implemented design and localization work on iOS for New Words with Friends. 

Also, in a team of five, developed an original mobile game (Unity) from ideation to playable prototype in four weeks, winning 1st place (out of ~7 teams) in Zynga’s Intern Innovation competition.

positions.title: Engineering Fellow
positions.description: At Zynga.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Gameplay and achievements for Knight Strike on mobile.
Part-time while studying at university.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
2011 - 2013 Teach weekly labs of 20 students, grade homework, plan lessons, and answer questions for Intro to Computer Science in Java.

2014 - Provide guidance and grading for Digital Media Design Senior Projects spanning a wide range of topics and technologies. Tutor and grade for Intro Computer Graphics in C++ and OpenGL.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed an extensible telemetry module on the client that tracks player actions to generate data for analytics and customer service in each iteration of Madden and NCAA Ultimate Team. Credited in Madden 25.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Tested, documented, and integrated new tools for a virtual human toolkit including physics simulations and animation blend shapes, working primarily between Unity and Maya.

Creation of a mixed-reality shooting gallery game (Unity, C#, C++) including authoring of assets/animations and improvements to the infrared vision system that detects user and prop locations.

http://ict.usc.edu/
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Graphics · Maya · C++ · Game Development · C# · Unity

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted in development of CHOFit (Carbon - Hydrogen - Oxygen Fit) software which analyzes data sets generated by ultrahigh resolution mass spectrometry and fits combinations of molecular compositions to atomic weights and ranks them based on heuristic algorithms.

Main task was transferring the existing program to the Lazarus programming interface using Pascal and designing a user-friendly GUI for it. Also refined the program, adding additional functions and improving the ranking algorithms. Ran basic tests of data sets through the program for analysis.

positions.title: Residential Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching and residential duties for a high school computer science camp

company.name: UPenn Summer Academy of Applied Science and Technology

positions.title: Teacher's Assistant
positions.description: General office tasks, customer relations, managing students and scheduling, tutoring high school math and reading, assisting in organizing outreach events

positions.title: Courtesy Clerk
positions.description: Bagging, cart pushing, cleaning, and other types of customer service and manual labor

educations.fieldOfStudy: Digital Media Design, Minor: Fine Arts
